simple.meaning: מְבוּכָה (mᵉbûwkâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “perplexity.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְבוּכָה (H3998) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 22:5, with occurrences in Isaiah, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְבוּכָה (H3998) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְבוּכָה (H3998) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְבוּכָה (mᵉbûwkâh) / H3998 is traced through Isaiah 22:5, Micah 7:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
